cases.name: simple
cases.desc: One substitution with anchors on both sides

cases.name: anchor-before-only
cases.desc: Anchor on one side is enough when it is unique

files.app.rb:
class App
  def run
  end
end

result.app.rb:
class App
  def start
  end
end

cases.name: two-substitutions
cases.desc: Several substitutions in one pattern

cases.name: insertion
cases.desc: An empty old part inserts

cases.name: deletion
cases.desc: An empty new part deletes

cases.name: assertion
cases.desc: A section with no substitution asserts and moves the cursor

cases.name: sequential-sections
cases.desc: Each section is searched after the previous match, so a later 'a' is unambiguous

cases.name: ambiguous-after-cursor
cases.desc: Exactly once means once in the text after the cursor

cases.name: anchor-mismatch
cases.desc: An anchor that does not match byte for byte (here, extra indentation) refuses

cases.name: multiline-text-anchor-ok
cases.desc: The anchor must match the file's bytes exactly

cases.name: replace-all-in-scope
cases.desc: RS replaces every occurrence between this section's match and the next

files.t.rb:
count = 0
def tally(items)
  count = 0
  items.each { count += 1 }
  count
end
count

result.t.rb:
count = 0
def tally(items)
  total = 0
  items.each { total += 1 }
  total
end
count

cases.name: replace-all-to-eof
cases.desc: After the last section the scope runs to the end of the file

cases.name: replace-all-whole-file
cases.desc: RS before any section applies to the whole file (up to the first match)

cases.name: replace-all-in-order
cases.desc: Several RS lines apply in order

cases.name: two-files
cases.desc: Several files in one diff

cases.name: note-and-dead-section
cases.desc: A note is skipped; a dead section is parsed and ignored

cases.name: no-match
cases.desc: A pattern that matches nothing refuses the whole diff

cases.name: ambiguous
cases.desc: A pattern that matches twice refuses

cases.name: replace-all-nothing
cases.desc: A replace-all with zero occurrences refuses

cases.name: replace-all-empty-old
cases.desc: A replace-all needs a non-empty old part

cases.name: wrong-shape
cases.desc: A heading that contradicts the diff tool refuses

cases.name: dead-file-line
cases.desc: A dead FS kills only the path line; what follows attaches to the previous file

cases.name: dead-section-replace-attaches
cases.desc: RS lines after a dead GS attach to the previous live section

cases.name: text-note-in-body
cases.desc: A text note between lines is skipped

cases.name: note-in-pattern
cases.desc: A note after a unit is not a unit

cases.name: commit-tolerated
cases.desc: An ETB between lines is a no-op

cases.name: overlapping-ambiguous
cases.desc: Matches are counted at every position: aa occurs twice in aaa

cases.name: same-path-twice
cases.desc: The same path twice in one diff refuses

cases.name: bytes-after-eot
cases.desc: Bytes after EOT refuse

cases.name: text-path
cases.desc: A path is a name, never text

cases.name: dead-heading-key
cases.desc: A dead heading key is ignored; the FS after it is live

cases.name: missing-file
cases.desc: A path that does not exist refuses
